description: HBN 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：hbn 表型/刺激提取；hbn 质控汇总；hbn 复制整理为 BIDS 目录。

method_refs.label: hbn 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge HBN phenotype tables for downstream analysis。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing HBN phenotype CSV/TSV files (directory); phenotype_file: Direct path to HBN phenotype CSV/TSV file (file); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv for filtering (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: hbn 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries and exclusion lists for HBN。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: hbn 复制整理为 BIDS 目录
method_refs.role: Reorganize HBN raw data into BIDS-style directory structure。 Inputs: input: Path to HBN raw data directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/.

name: hbn-skill
